The Aircraft Warning Service . . . mission was to “observe the movement of aircraft and to collect and exhibit the information obtained” in order to protect the nation’s coasts and adjacent territories and bases against enemy attack by land or by sea.

—Justine Christianson, Historic American Engineering Record, National Park Service, 2005

Which technological advance from World War II fulfilled this mission?
